audience: sales and relationship teams who keep contacts in Folk CRM

useCases.title: List contacts with their companies
useCases.text: The AI lists people with names, emails and linked companies, with filters, and gives a short summary.

useCases.title: Review and compare your companies
useCases.text: The AI lists companies with filters and opens one, so you can compare the company records.

useCases.title: Read recent notes in the workspace
useCases.text: The AI lists notes, for one person or company or by full text and creation date, and sums up the latest ones.

useCases.title: Add a contact or a company
useCases.text: The AI creates a person or a company with the details you give. A person can be placed in groups and linked to companies.

useCases.title: Update a contact or company, or add a note
useCases.text: The AI changes fields on a person or a company and can add a note to it. List fields like emails replace the old values.
